subject: 辽金北方·酒楼／茶肆（原创扩展；历史细部待考）
prompt: Make a minimal precise edit to this existing building sprite. Keep the same camera projection, building geometry and footprint, every roof and ground corner, every window and table, and the clean transparent background. Remove the red fabric hangings. Change the pale wall plaster to a slightly warmer northern buff earthen plaster, and make the tiles sober gray. The result is an anonymous Liao-Jin northern wine-house, with no new ornaments. Preserve the input Song-kit texture detail and upper-left lighting. Extend the long front edge of the thin paving just six percent, keeping side depth unchanged, to reach a 12-by-9 rectangular footprint. Ground edges 2:1 dimetric slopes +0.5/-0.5; upright columns, no perspective. Do not add a background, glow, shadow aura, fog, framing, signage, people or vegetation. Keep empty pixels genuinely transparent, and solid building pixels fully opaque. Do not enlarge the building to fill the canvas.
negative: 文字、人物、水印、现代物、背景街景、厚地台、宫廷彩画、裁切、透视汇聚

references.role: 宋基线微小材质编辑参考

created_time_basis: 生成源文件mtime，非服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize with integer rounding
processing.excluded_operations: no repaint, alpha thresholding, warping, flip, anisotropic correction or synthetic corners

geometry_qa.precision_note: 逐张view_image，另一只读代理独立读取同层薄地脚L/F/R；后三点非理论拟合。隐藏后角未实测；不拉伸纠偏。

visual_qa.method: 逐张view_image；独立代理底缘量测

notes: 第3次运行选第2候选：酒楼宽深比误差4.43%，右轴斜率-0.540仍略超±0.03；不宣称严格双轴通过。旧rejected_candidate及input.json为首轮历史，首轮entry另存sources/pre-repair3；完整本轮提示词/测点见repair_record。单视图、candidate、原创扩展及年代细部待考沿用。

rejected_candidate.prompt: Generate a revised NEW northern Liao-Jin town building asset using reference only for realism, textures and type. Correct the ground footprint projection: orthographic dimetric 2:1, ground edges at exactly26.565degrees to horizontal, slopes+0.5 and-0.5. Do NOT copy the reference camera or ground shape. Transparent RGBA, no background, halo, people, writing or markings, no thick plinth. Front entrance faces screen lower-left. Screen-upper-left light, short contact shadow lower-right. All roof and ground perimeter fully contained with margins. Northern Liao/Jin11th–12th century warm buff plaster, dark timber and plain gray tile, modest broad eaves; no Ming/Qing palace decoration. ONE broad two-story wine-house and tea-shop on footprint12east-west by9north-south. CRITICAL visible thin ground polygon LEFT to FRONT projected x-distance must be1.333times FRONT to RIGHT x-distance; front facade must be visibly broader than side facade. Eliminate side extension that distorts rectangular footprint. Main gray tile gable roof, plain upstairs wood balcony and shutters, lower-left veranda with3simple tables, benches and wine jars, no red cloth or lanterns, no plants. Warm buff wall infill, sober dark timber. Exact2:1 ground slopes with full left,front,right corners.
